title: The smallest paper orbital strike canon
description:
Hello, my name is TheeDumbRock (TDR) and this is my smallest orbital strike cannon that uses wind charges for accelerant and my 5 brain cells to make. This design uses 66 blocks and works on most versions as this video was recorded on 26.2.
